_comment: Where Nick posts from. Drives the one-tap action links in the digest email. Read at runtime by send_digest.py — edit and the next digest picks it up, no code change and no redeploy.
_identity_note: Nick posts as himself, not as a DailyCoder brand account (confirmed 2026-08-27). Replies stay first-person and lean on 20+ years of actually building software. If this ever changes to 'brand', the voice rules in agent/social-digest.md need updating too.
_mastodon_note: Set 2026-08-27. Enables /authorize_interaction links that open a remote post inside Nick's own instance already set up to reply — one tap instead of copy-paste-search.

autopost._enabled_note: OFF. Turn on ONLY after reading _autopost_rules below and after MASTODON_ACCESS_TOKEN exists in /srv/agents/nick/env. Flipping this to true is a deliberate act with consequences on a real account.
autopost._originals_only_note: HARD RULE, enforced in post_mastodon.py, not just here. Auto-post original statuses (the daily puzzle) only. NEVER auto-reply and NEVER auto-mention anyone. Unsolicited automated replies to strangers are what gets an account reported as a bot — that risk is the entire reason this exists in a scoped form rather than as 'let the agent post'.
autopost.ai_disclosure: 🤖 Puzzle written by an AI agent; posted automatically.
autopost._ai_disclosure_note: REQUIRED, not decorative. mastodon.social rule 1008: 'Content created by others must be attributed, and use of generative AI must be disclosed.' The DailyCoder puzzles are LLM-written, so any automated post carrying one must disclose it. post_mastodon.py refuses to post without a non-empty disclosure while autopost is enabled.

_bluesky_note: Optional, cosmetic only. Compose intent links work without it.
_enabled_compose_note: Which platforms get a pre-filled compose button for standalone posts. Hacker News and Reddit are deliberately absent: neither has a compose-intent URL, and on both the right move is replying inside an existing thread anyway, which the per-item action link already handles.
